_doc: Display face of each exotic weapon's name (weapons.json category 'exotic'; read by src/ui/quality_text.gd). 'weapons': weapon id -> Google Fonts family and its file under res://assets/fonts/ (every exotic must be listed; tests check the file loads). 'families': per family, its author (credits) and licence file (license_id: OFL-1.1 or Apache-2.0) beside the font (OFL-<family>.txt or APACHE-<family>.txt, copied into licenses/ by tools/build_windows.sh), plus optional 'scale' (multiplies the caller's font size so the face reads at the same height; default 1) and 'case' ('title': Title Case, for faces that look wrong in all caps; 'upper': ALL CAPS; default: as the caller gives it). A file may be a .tres FontVariation over a variable font (Playfair Display Italic at weight 500 over PlayfairDisplay-Italic-VF.ttf). Owner's picks (2026-11-06).
